title: May Admin MVP Readiness Board — Phase 1 Build Gate
decisionRationale: All 5 MVP modules are operational. All 6 automatic stop conditions PASS. The investigation workbench can complete real investigations without manual report traversal. The student data bridge is architecturally designed with import/export contracts and privacy controls — student data population is deferred scope, not a blocking gap.

questionLookup.capability: Single CLI call returns 7-section investigation report for any QID
questionLookup.validation: 26/26 valid QIDs across all 5 packs, all 6 domains. Error handling correct.

challengeReview.capability: 35 challenges cataloged, 12 triaged with classification and routing
challengeReview.validation: Investigation coverage at 46%. Priority scoring active. Classification reasonably consistent.
challengeReview.notes: 23 challenges still untriaged — need full pass before go-live

sessionLookup.capability: 40 sessions cataloged, 535 unique QIDs linked, 0 duplicate or orphan references
sessionLookup.validation: Post-S253 deep-link remediation confirmed: all links bidirectional, all sessions registered.

recommendationReview.capability: 4 REC-IDs with 2,382 QIDs linked across CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity tiers
recommendationReview.validation: All 4 REC-IDs active with target QID lists. Recommendation→Investigation chain functional.
recommendationReview.notes: DL-021 recommendations not yet linked to specific QIDs

investigationDashboard.validation: 19/19 follow valid state transitions. 0 orphan references. CLI operational (--list, --summary, --stats).
investigationDashboard.notes: 17 of 19 investigations are OPEN (seeded from challenge registry). Few have moved beyond OPEN. Lifecycle is operational but underutilized.

dataCompleteness.detail: Question, session, challenge, recommendation, investigation, and certification data all available and linked. Student performance data is the single known gap — design complete, no operational data.

traceability.detail: Question↔Session (535 unique QIDs, 1,163 links), Question↔Recommendation (2,382 links), Question↔Challenge (35 bidirectional), Question↔Certification (77 planned). All chains verified post-S253. Single P1-EC-004 certification state anomaly.

investigationIntegrity.detail: 8/8 workbench cases complete without manual report traversal. All engines operational. Single-CLI investigation produces complete 7-section report.

studentIntegration.detail: Canonical record schema designed (5 levels). Import/export contracts defined. Privacy/governance controls specified. Zero operational data to validate against.

conditions.detail: 0 critical findings. S253 repair confirmed: 5/5 PASS
2,540 QIDs registered. State counts consistent. 0 corruption detected.
35 challenges, all with bidirectional QID links. 0 orphan references post-S253.
32/32 PASS. All 6 rules active. Zero violations.

executiveDecision.summary: The CMA Part 1 Exam Simulator investigation platform has transitioned from functional to trustworthy to reliable. All 5 May Admin MVP modules are operational with documented scores between 85-100. The investigation workbench can complete real investigations without manual report traversal — an admin can look up a question, review its challenges, trace its session history, view recommendations, and check certification events with a single CLI command. The student data bridge is fully designed: canonical record, import/export contracts, privacy controls, and governance integration are specified — student data population is deferred scope.

phase1_deferred: Student Performance Analytics (requires student data population)
Student Exposure Index (requires student data population)
phase1_prerequisites: Complete challenge triage pass on remaining 23 challenges
Link DL-021 recommendation to specific QIDs

blockersForProduction.blocker: Challenge triage at 34% (12/35). 23 untriaged challenges will appear unclassified in admin dashboard.
blockersForProduction.resolution: Run full triage pass before May MVP go-live

blockersForProduction.blocker: Student data gap — zero operational student records. Analytics module will show empty dashboards.
blockersForProduction.resolution: Implement student data export from may-learner-state.js → student_exports/ directory. Populate with learner data when available.
blockersForProduction.blocks: Student-facing analytics only — does not block admin investigation capabilities

executiveDecision.nextRecommendedSession: S258 — Pre-Phase1 Gap Remediation (challenge triage completion + P1-EC-004 investigation + DL-021 QID linkage)
